statement: Pi triggers compaction against a configurable reserve threshold, summarizes the older branch, keeps recent entries, tracks file operations, and preserves the full append-only session history outside the reduced model context.

display_text.zh-CN: Pi 会在可配置 reserve threshold 上触发 compaction，总结较旧分支、保留近期 entries、跟踪文件操作，同时把完整 append-only session history 保留在缩减后的模型上下文之外。
display_text.en: Pi triggers compaction against a configurable reserve threshold, summarizes the older branch, keeps recent entries, tracks file operations, and preserves the full append-only session history outside the reduced model context.

notes: Compaction is explicitly lossy; retained task quality is not yet measured by this project.
